messages:
elaine: FYI — RFC follow-up on multi-scope API keys + RBAC migration. Need a short plan for backward compatibility and service-to-service delegation.

sasha: quick thought: prefer a single token type with explicit claims instead of multiple token flavours. Less surface area to support.

matt: single token is attractive but increases verification complexity (more claims to validate) and will bloat logs if we include full scope lists every call.

dominik: proposal sketch: JWT-style tokens with a small set of top-level claims: `sub`, `iss`, `aud`, `exp`, plus `scopes` (array) and optional `actor` for svc->svc. Example payload:```{
  "sub": "svc:redwood-ingest",
  "iss": "redwood-auth",
  "aud": "api.redwood.ai",
  "exp": 1719900000,
  "scopes": ["org:read","project:write:proj-123"],
  "actor": {"id": "user:lia", "type": "human"}
}```

jia: how do we map existing opaque API keys? We have thousands in DB mapped to account/project. Can't rotate them all immediately.

elaine: plan idea: compatibility mode — keep old opaque keys in DB, but support an `exchange` endpoint that returns a scoped JWT for a legacy key. Over time, encourage apps to call exchange and cache the JWT locally.

sasha: +1. That reduces change required in consumers. But we must rate-limit exchange and track audit.

matt: add-on: issue short-lived JWTs (e.g., 1h) from exchange so we can revoke by disabling the legacy key mapping. Also need refresh flow for long-running jobs.

dominik: agreed. Also think about token size: store only scope references in tokens (e.g., `scope_refs: [r1,r2]`) and resolve on introspection for heavy checks. Keeps per-request payload small.

elaine: tradeoffs: introspection adds latency and operational complexity. We might allow two modes: inline-scopes (low-latency checks) vs ref-scopes (smaller token + introspect). Customer chooses per workload.

jia: SDK impact: `client = Redwood(apiKey)` -> we'd add `client.exchangeLegacy()` and `client.withPrincipal(actor)` helpers. CLI: `redwood auth exchange --legacy-key <key>`

ops-bot: Incident reminder: previous scope mismatch caused perms leak on 2023-11-02, see #incidents. Please include audit hooks.

elaine: action items: 1) eng-security to draft migration RFC for exchange endpoint + short-lived JWTs (owner: dominik). 2) infra to evaluate introspection latency and caching (owner: matt). 3) devex to plan SDK/CLI changes and docs (owner: jia). 4) product to define default mode and rollout messaging.

sasha: acked. I'll add a short timeline for deprecation of legacy-only keys (phased, opt-in) in the RFC.

matt: one more edge: svc->svc impersonation. We should support an `on_behalf_of` claim that is only present if the caller has delegation rights. Logged for audit.

dominik: will include that in the token examples and introspection checks.

elaine: cool. Let's meet tomorrow 10am to review the draft. If anyone has blocking concerns post them here. :thumbsup:
